newsitem.title: NORWAY: Hydro cuts European pure magnesium price.
newsitem.headline: Hydro cuts European pure magnesium price.

text.p: Norsk Hydro said on Friday its subsidiary Hydro Magnesium was cutting its European Producer Price for pure magnesium to DM 5.95/kg from DM 6.30/kg.
The cut is effective from Monday or as contracts permit, a Hydro statement said.

"The change reflects a decline of prices following negotiations for fourth-quarter deliveries," the statement said. "While demand for alloy magnesium continues to display good growth, the larger pure market remains weaker than expected."
"Recovery of demand for magnesium is partly dependent on a return to normal purchasing and stocking patterns in the aluminium industry," it said.
Hydro said one consequence was that Russian and Ukrainan magnesium was now imported by traders at prices well below the minimum levels established by the European Commission.

"In the coming months prospects are that prices will take on a firming trend. A principal contributing factor will be the accumulated effect of production adjustments by western producers, plant closures in China and a probable delayed start-up at Dead Sea Magnesium in Israel," Hydro said.
